items.title: Liverpool lead Chelsea in Camara race - Wednesday's gossip
items.summary: Liverpool leading Chelsea in race for Monaco's Lamine Camara, Barcelona rule out moves for Virgil van Dijk and Bruno Fernandes, and ex-Crystal Palace winger Wilfried Zaha could rejoin the club.

items.title: Madrid-bound Gabriel posts farewell Man Utd message
items.summary: TeenagerJJ Gabriel posts a farewell message saying Manchester United will always be part of his story, as he prepares for a likely move to Real Madrid.

items.title: Were any current Man City players signed during charges period?
items.summary: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team looks at whether any Manchester City players were signed during the time the club have been found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.

items.title: Arsenal had more than 20 players on shortlist to capitalise on title win
items.summary: Senior football correspondent Sami Mokbel goes inside Arsenal's bid to capitalise on their Premier League title and strengthen their squad this summer.

items.title: Man Utd expected to back Poch in January transfer window
items.summary: Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino is expected to be backed in the January transfer window as the club aim to address their disappointing start to the season.

items.title: Arsenal willing to make sales to beat Chelsea and Liverpool to Scott signing
items.summary: Arsenal are one of three top Premier League clubs interested in signing Bournemouth and England midfielder Alex Scott.

items.title: JJ Gabriel says goodbye to Man Utd with Real Madrid move close
items.summary: JJ Gabriel has announced he is leaving Manchester United as he looks forward to his "next chapter" at Real Madrid.
